title: Reading, Writing and Showing Numbers up to 100
seo_title: Grade 1 Reading and Writing Numbers Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Read and write numerals up to 100; recognize and represent numbers up to 100 using a variety of concrete and pictorial models.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets on reading and writing numbers to 100 for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: number words, numerals and tens and ones blocks. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_big: Tens first, then ones: 47 is forty-seven.
key_sub: A long block is 1 ten. A cube is 1 one.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Read a number from left to right: 47 is forty-seven.
  • The teens end in “teen”: thirteen, fourteen. The tens end in “ty”: thirty, forty.
  • Blocks show numbers: a long block is 1 ten, a small cube is 1 one.
  • 4 tens and 7 ones make 47.

Examples

Example

sixty-two

6 tens, 2 ones

Answer: 62

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
14 or 41?Fourteen is 1 ten and 4 ones: 14.
Teen or ty?Sixteen is 16; sixty is 60.
Ones as tensLong blocks are tens; cubes are ones.
